name: coach-note-only-close
description: Genuine close-out with real content that's narrative/reflective rather than a concrete training-log fact. Previously found (pre-strip-down) that this exact shape of conversation ('nothing to log today really') sometimes made Gemini skip coach_note entirely, treating 'nothing structural happened' as license to skip the note too - this transcript exists to catch that regression specifically. Consistency touch for PR #428: added actionFieldsAbsent - the athlete explicitly says there's nothing concrete to log (no injury, no quest, no template ask), so every closing-only action field besides coach_note should stay unset here, and that's now asserted directly rather than left implicit. No extraContext added - this transcript's whole point is a close with nothing structural to reference, so giving Gemini real ids here would blur what it's actually testing.
